title: •Down With The Emperor!
caption: •Down With The Emperor! (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. All immunity to attrition is -3. You may not fire {lightsaber} weapons. If opponent just lost a Dark Jedi or a battle, they lose 1 Force. During your draw phase, use 3 Force or place this Effect in Used Pile. {alter}
lore: News of Imperial defeat inspires the citizens of the galaxy. A major loss seriously undermines the Empire’s ability to function.

notes: Unique. Inline icon in 'may not fire [black square, green blade] weapons' → {lightsaber} per this run's instructions; the wiki stub reads 'vehicle weapons', which does not match the printed glyph (same glyph as Access Denied's 'non-lightsaber'). Red circle-slash A at the end, printed tight against 'Pile.' → {alter}. Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in Empire’s (wiki has straight). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright = Special Edition 1998 form, legible in outline on the scan. Modern: V0-L-downwiththeemperor.gif (745 px); VB4 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
